we developed and validated a at home collection dried blood spot (DBS) collection kit and an assay that can detect SARS-CoV2 specific antibodies.
we developed and validated a serology test to detect antibodies to SARS-CoV-2 in dried blood spots collected at home.
we developed and validated a at home fingerprick dried blood spot collection method and assay that can accurately detect antibodies to the SARS CoV2 virus.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of at home finger prick collection kits and analysis methods to detect antibodies to the novel coronavirus SARS CoV-2, the causative agent of the COVID 19 pandemic.
the development of at home finger prick collection of dried blood spots for serosurveillance of SARS CoV2.
the development and validation a serological assay to identify COVID 19 antibodies in finger prick dried blood collected at home.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study shows a new method for the detection of antibodies against the SARS-CoV-2 virus in finger prick dried blood specimens collected at home and shipped to a laboratory.
the study demonstrates a high degree of sensitivity and specificity in detecting SARS CoV2 antibodies from finger prick dried blood samples, and the method can be used for at home testing.
the assay is a highly accurate and sensitive test for detecting SARS CoV-2 antibodies in finger prick dried blood samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method to collect blood at home and then test for COVID 19 antibodies in the blood.
we developed a method to detect SARS-CoV-2 antibodies in at-home collected dried blood spots and demonstrated 100% accuracy across the US.
we have developed a serology test that can be performed on a dried blood spot that was collected at home by the individual.
The main takeaway from our work is that

at home finger prick blood spot collection is a viable method for serological testing of SARS CoV-2 infection and can be implemented in a wide range of settings to facilitate unbiased serological testing.
we have developed a simple, low cost, at home finger prick blood collection kit that can be used for the collection of dried blood spots for the detection of SARS CoV2 antibodies.
we have shown a finger prick dried blood sample can be collected by the general population and used in a serological assay to determine if they are positive for COVID 19.
